mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_logs (visited_on, visitor_key, path, user_agent) VALUES (#{day}, #{visitorKey}, #{path}, #{userAgent})
INSERT INTO post_view_logs (post_id, viewed_on, visitor_key) VALUES (#{postId}, #{day}, #{visitorKey})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) FROM visit_logs WHERE visited_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_logs WHERE visited_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_view_logs WHERE viewed_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT visited_on AS stat_day, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS page_views FROM visit_logs WHERE visited_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY visited_on ORDER BY visited_on
SELECT viewed_on AS stat_day, COUNT(*) AS post_views FROM post_view_logs WHERE viewed_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY viewed_on ORDER BY viewed_on
